title: What ClayArena is
summary: ClayArena is a clay shooting website focused on Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting: competition results, shooter profiles, a calendar, videos, season recaps, shooting grounds and coaches.

body.html: ClayArena (clayarena.com) is a website about clay shooting: Parcours de Chasse – Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting. It shows who shot and how, where the next competitions are and where you can train.

The core of ClayArena is competition results. Each competition has a results table with places and the number of targets broken. At some events the scores are updated while the shooting is still going on. Shooter profiles are built from these results.
A shooter profile is one person's page: their competitions and key figures, such as accuracy. What the figures mean is explained in What the numbers in a profile mean.

ClayArena also has a competition calendar, videos from competitions and season recaps. There are catalogues of shooting grounds and of coaches as well. More in Videos, season recaps and the competition calendar and Finding a coach and a shooting ground on ClayArena.
ClayArena is also preparing ClayAway: training tours with a coach. They have not launched yet and will start later: Travelling with a coach on a ClayAway tour.
ClayArena is also a place to learn: this Academy, a glossary of terms, and a plain-language guide to the FITASC rules with a rules trainer.

key_points.html: ClayArena is a clay shooting website focused on Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting.
Its core is competition results; shooter profiles are built from them.
It also has a calendar, videos, season recaps and catalogues of grounds and coaches.
ClayAway training tours are being prepared and have not launched yet.

quiz.q: What are shooter profiles on ClayArena built from?
quiz.explain: A profile gathers the shooter's competitions, that is, competition results.
ClayAway will be ClayArena's organised training tours with a coach; it has not launched yet.

quiz.q: Where do you look for competitions that have not happened yet?
quiz.explain: The calendar lists planned, ongoing and finished competitions with dates and venues.
